author: KanekoaTheGreat
text:
🚨 Thank you, Candace Owens, for finally helping Zach Costello discover that the person in the footage is Tyler Robinson after he spent a year pushing your incoherent nonsense.

Tyler’s parents, boyfriend, and Discord chat has already identified him.

And Tyler identified himself:

“It was me. Look at the pictures from the surveillance footage. It was me.”

But your newly leaked footage finally helped one of your biggest supporters catch up.

In your typical dishonest fashion, you mentioned Zach Costello and his video today without addressing what he actually said.

Instead, you spun an entirely separate conspiracy theory about the footage.

But that’s okay. 

We’re used to it after a year of you failing to produce a shred of evidence that Egyptian planes, the U.S. military, French Legionnaires, exploding microphones, Erika Kirk, or TPUSA killed Charlie.

You move the goalposts every time the evidence catches up with you, and you refuse to show your audience the other side of the argument.

But at least you finally convinced Zach Costello that the person in the footage looks like Tyler Robinson.

@RealCandaceO 
@ZachCostello_
